plan.text: Uber's Employee Stock Purchase Plan lets eligible employees buy Uber shares at a 15 percent discount.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 1, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
source.quote: The ESPP provides for twelve-month offering periods, and each offering period includes two purchase periods of approximately six months . The ESPP allows eligible employees to purchase shares of our common stock at a 15 percent discount on the lower price of either (i) the offering period begin date or (ii) the purchase date.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001543151-26-000015, filed February 13, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-26-000125, filed March 23, 2026), read on EDGAR. Uber's 10-K tables list years in ascending order (2023, 2024, 2025), so the 2025 value is the last number in each quote. LEADER: Khosrowshahi is a hired CEO. He beneficially owns 2,380,203 shares as of March 2, 2026 (982,544 held, 496,958 RSUs vesting within 60 days, 900,701 exercisable options), marked * (less than 1%), so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: the proxy gives only the filing dates of the 13G reports (Vanguard Schedule 13G/A October 31, 2025; BlackRock January 26, 2024, stale; Capital Research February 13, 2025), not their as-of dates, so asOf is null; percentages use the March 2, 2026 share count. STOCK COMP: 1,826 is the cash-flow add-back and the XBRL ShareBasedCompensation fact. BUYBACKS rose to 6,523 in 2025 from 1,252 in 2024. GEOGRAPHY: the country table (United States, United Kingdom, all other countries) is used, as in the prior edition; the same note now also gives a regional table (US&CAN 26,469, LatAm 3,327, EMEA 16,364, APAC 5,857 million). U.K. revenue is presented largely on a gross basis since Uber became the merchant of transportation there in 2022 (payments to drivers go into cost of revenue).
